items.description: SILENTCONNECT is a newly discovered multi-stage malware loader that has been silently targeting Windows machines since at least March 2025. It uses VBScript, in-memory PowerShell execution, and PEB masquerading to install the ConnectWise ScreenConnect remote monitoring and management tool on victim systems.
